summary: The defective receipt generator wrote bare binary basenames into SHA256SUMS while the workflow verified from the output root and stored the binaries under bin/. The repaired head records explicit relative paths such as bin/gaster and bin/irecovery, uses those paths when generating SHA256SUMS, and passed the exact-head reviewed tools workflow.
learning_objectives: Generate integrity manifests in the same path namespace and working-directory model used by the downstream verifier.
Preserve relative directories in checksum records when artifacts are stored below the verification root.
Test producer and verifier together with the exact runtime working directory instead of validating each component in isolation.
